summary: Design generative AI governance, workflows and adoption measures. Practise use-case triage and operating-model decisions in a five-day course.
lede: Enterprise generative AI adoption training helps product owners, governance and risk professionals, and business leaders turn pilots into controlled workflows. Participants practise prioritising use cases, mapping decision rights and risk controls, and designing human-review workflows with adoption and value measures, using the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 as governance references. The course develops practical operating artefacts, including a use-case portfolio, workflow blueprint and KPI scorecard; technical topics receive operational rather than implementation-level treatment.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who must turn generative AI experiments into controlled business workflows, with clear decision rights and evidence of value.
modules: NIST Generative AI Profile Risk Controls
AI Operating Model Value and Reporting
prerequisites: Working familiarity with business processes, enterprise technology projects or AI use cases is recommended. No coding or model-development experience is required; advanced topics such as retrieval-augmented generation and model evaluation are addressed at conceptual or operational level.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
